Effective date: 2 September 2026

These terms cover the Swarm Support Watcher, a Discord application operated by the Swarm Foundation on the official Swarm Discord server.

The service

The bot monitors designated public support channels on the Swarm Discord server and forwards likely questions to the Swarm Foundation team, so a team member can reply personally. It is a convenience for faster community support — it does not reply on its own, and it is not a substitute for official documentation or support commitments.

No warranty

The bot is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind. The Swarm Foundation does not guarantee that every question will be noticed, forwarded, or answered, nor any response time. Suggested answers drafted by the bot are internal aids for the team; only replies actually sent by a team member represent the team's answer, and even those are provided for general information, not as professional advice.

Use of the server

Use of the Swarm Discord server remains governed by Discord's own Terms of Service and Community Guidelines, as well as the server rules. Nothing in these terms overrides them.

Data

How the bot handles messages and personal data is described in the privacy policy.

Changes and discontinuation

The Swarm Foundation may change how the bot works, amend these terms, or discontinue the bot at any time. Material changes will be reflected on this page with an updated effective date.

Contact

Questions about these terms: info@ethswarm.org.
